description: A full snapshot of what is breaking out on TikTok right now, optionally for one niche: the videos gaining views fastest (ranked by views per day, each with its creator, views and link), plus the 24 hashtags and 12 sounds that appear most often on those videos. Without an API key: 5 videos, 5 hashtags and 3 sounds.

category.description: Niche slug, e.g. beauty, gaming, food, fitness

name: get_trending
